# Build decisions log

Choices builders made where mvp-spec.md v1.4 is silent, ambiguous or contradictory (pick, log, keep going). Logan signs them off at the milestone gates. A value chosen here is a named constant in code, with a comment pointing back to its row.

| D574 | build-plan M9.8, D420, D422, D430, D440, D461 | How the leak test knows the truth, what it reads and what counts as a leak | The truth is an Omniscient twin of the same state (the save loaded into a second `Sim`, Omniscient on, saved and loaded again so every view, the recap and projection too, is built with it). A subject's true values are the float literals of its Omniscient view entries (row, detail, units, tech, rating, filing, projection, recaps and expected rows, births and listings, industry-detail rows, statements) that its non-Omniscient entries do not hold, nonzero, rendered every way a figure is written (money, price, percent, ratio, number, the three gains, a chart's two-decimal number, basis points; never a count, and no rendering without a non-zero digit), less every rendering of the numbers its non-Omniscient entries and the public context (countries, zones, rates, cycle, clock) hold. The scan reads every Text, every table model row and every chart readout. A screen's loose text is checked against the subject it is about (its own page, tab, card, bar results and F3), or on a page about no banded subject against the subjects it links to; a table row against the first subject it links to or names. Band ends on screen are not checked as figures: every view band is checked against its truth directly (strictly inside, statements paired by period; a money band's ends never render as its truth), and a band the UI derives keeps its truth inside (D430), so an end that renders like another figure's truth is a coincidence. Canaries, a truth written into a page as loose text and as a table row linking its subject, must be found. The screens are drawn from a plain reload of the state and the twin is a reload of the same save, and the test asserts the shell's views equal a second plain reload's: a load rebuilds every view at the current tick, while a running game keeps slower views as of their last rebuild, so the live views would not match the twin's truth. Scope: the test proves the UI is faithful to the views (no screen shows a value the views hide); which figures the views band rests on the sim's tests (D420 to D440). Integer-typed figures and values the UI could derive from truths are not scanned. The sim allows Omniscient only with debug assertions, so the release run builds the sim with them and the game crate plain release (docs/build/m9-checks.md); a release run without that stops with a message.
